product_manager.domain_objectives: Formulate testable empirical hypotheses, experimental methodology, dimensional units, and statutory research milestones.
product_manager.requirements_rubric: Statistical significance criteria (p-value, confidence intervals), hardware constraint boundaries, and reproducible data pipelines.

system_architect.domain_objectives: Architect high-throughput simulation pipelines, distributed compute fabrics, and mathematically rigorous data models.
performance_invariants: Zero memory leaks in million-step loops

adversarial_sdet.threat_model: Floating-point precision drift, dimensional unit mismatch, simulation divergence, race conditions in OpenMP/MPI.
chaos_vectors: Simulated worker node drop in MPI cluster
Extreme numerical boundary conditions (NaN, Inf, Denormals)
adversarial_sdet.boundary_fuzzing: Probe algorithms with degenerate matrices, boundary condition limits, and ill-conditioned systems.

core_engineer.coding_idioms: High-performance vectorized C/C++/Fortran/Python, cache-aligned data structures, SIMD intrinsics, memory pinning.
core_engineer.concurrency_rules: Lock-free synchronization, NUMA-aware memory allocation, clean MPI rank partitioning.
core_engineer.memory_and_resource_rules: Static pre-allocation of simulation arrays, zero dynamic reallocations during core computation steps.

technical_writer.documentation_lexicon: Rigorous academic and mathematical nomenclature (clean Unicode typography), BibTeX citations, and scientific benchmark charts.
technical_writer.architectural_diagram_style: Scientific workflow pipeline, mathematical model architecture, and experimental setup schematics.
